about: Slice 2c.12a (issue #198). The variables a workflow might set, in the job's env, the step's env or a GITHUB_ENV write, to change what the egress action's own steps do with the key they hold. tests/egress/runner-variables.py reads this file; the escape tests' runner-variables jobs set every name in 'names' each of the three ways and record what a step run as the action's own steps are (/usr/bin/python3 -I -S, plain and inside a composite action) sees. 'expected' is what GitHub-hosted ubuntu-24.04 showed; a difference fails the job. Values are made-up paths and words, never secrets.

names.RUNNER_TEMP: egress.py puts AWF's binary and each run's private directory under it
names.RUNNER_TOOL_CACHE: a runner directory; the command can read /opt, the tool cache
names.RUNNER_WORKSPACE: the runner's parent of the workspace
names.GITHUB_WORKSPACE: egress.py copies the workspace from it for the command
names.GITHUB_OUTPUT: egress.py writes the action's outputs to it and hashes it
names.GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY: egress.py hashes it to see whether the command changed it
names.GITHUB_ENV: egress.py hashes it to see whether the command changed it
names.GITHUB_PATH: egress.py hashes it to see whether the command changed it
names.GITHUB_STATE: egress.py hashes it to see whether the command changed it
names.GITHUB_ACTION_PATH: action.yml finds egress.py from github.action_path (a context, not this variable)
names.GITHUB_API_URL: a runner URL a program could be pointed elsewhere with
names.GITHUB_SERVER_URL: a runner URL a program could be pointed elsewhere with
names.HOME: AWF and sudo read it; issue #194
names.TMPDIR: tempfile's first choice where it is given no dir
names.HTTPS_PROXY: urllib.request's proxy for the install step's one download
names.https_proxy: urllib.request reads the lower-case name first
names.http_proxy: urllib.request's proxy for http, lower case
names.ALL_PROXY: curl's and others' proxy for every scheme
names.NO_PROXY: hosts urllib.request reaches without a proxy
names.SSL_CERT_FILE: the CA file libcrypto trusts (left by D-071)
names.SSL_CERT_DIR: the CA directory libcrypto trusts (left by D-071)
names.LC_ALL: glibc reads a locale name with a slash as a path
names.LANG: glibc's default locale, read the same way
names.LOCPATH: glibc's locale directory (the action's steps empty it)
names.HOSTALIASES: glibc's resolver reads host aliases from this file
names.DOCKER_HOST: where the docker client sends its requests
names.DOCKER_CONFIG: the docker client's configuration and credentials directory
names.SUDO_ASKPASS: the program sudo -A runs to ask for a password
names.XDG_RUNTIME_DIR: where some clients look for sockets
